releaseNotes: v8.16.0: Import Tab Ergonomics & Source Plugins Engine Overhaul: 1) Reordered Import Tab (Tab 2): novel info card and Table of Contents (TOC) are now positioned directly at the top when a novel is fetched, moving search results to the bottom inside a clean collapsible drawer; 2) Source Plugins Engine Overhaul: full browser DOM Cheerio & htmlparser2 shims, resolving 'Untitled Novel' titles, enabling LNReader community scrapers, and auto-recovering missing titles from URL slugs; 3) Multi-Source Parallel Search: concurrent querying across installed plugins and built-in scrapers; 4) Plugin Catalog Polish: added language filter pills (All, EN, JA, ZH, ES, RU, KO) and one-tap Open site buttons.
